international.title: Meet Phil, the bar-tailed godwit tracked on a 6,800-mile round trip to Siberia
international.summary: Scientists use lightweight tracker to map wading bird’s extraordinary migration from Norfolk to the Arctic and back A bar-tailed godwit called Phil has completed a 6,800-mile journey from Norfolk to Siberia and back again, in the first mapping of the endurance feats of this long-distance migrant. A wading bird not much larger than a pigeon, the bar-tailed godwit is known for making the longest recorded non-stop migratory flight of any bird, with populations that visit Britain spending summers breeding in the Arctic Circle before retreating to the unfrozen wetlands of Britain in winter.
